# Stay

> Africa's verified property platform. Verified shortlets, homes and land across Africa with escrow-protected payments.

Stay independently inspects every shortlet, home and plot listed on the platform. Payments are held in PropertyEscrow™ and only released to the host or seller after the buyer confirms check-in or receipt of documents.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Stay, featured verified properties and trust pillars.
- [Explore](/explore): Search and filter verified shortlets across African cities.
- [Help](/profile/help): Frequently asked questions on escrow, verification, bookings and payouts.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth): Account access for travellers and verified agents.
